# exo_application_access_policy (Data Source)

Look up an existing ApplicationAccessPolicy object. Set identity to select it.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `identity` (String) Identity used to look up the object.

### Read-Only

- `access_right` (String) Maps to the -AccessRight parameter.
- `app_id` (Set of String) Maps to the -AppId parameter.
- `description` (String) Maps to the -Description parameter.
- `id` (String) Object identifier (GUID).
- `policy_scope_group_id` (String) Maps to the -PolicyScopeGroupId parameter.
